description: China Pumped Storage Hydropower Dataset is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Jingcai 竞蔡 Cai 蔡. The dataset of PSH projects in China, updated as of April 2024. Additional information and description shown in sheet 2. All information are collected by using open-source on Internet. If you want to cite this dataset, please retain the copyright of Jingcai Cai. This dataset has conduct a map, which also released by me. Coverage: national (CN); the metadata date the deposit to 2024. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
